title: BERT: Pre-training of Deep Bidirectional Transformers for Language Understanding
abstract: We introduce BERT, a new language representation model designed to pre-train deep bidirectional representations from unlabeled text.

title: Attention Is All You Need
venue: Advances in Neural Information Processing Systems
abstract: The dominant sequence transduction models are based on complex recurrent or convolutional neural networks that include an encoder and a decoder.

title: Language Models are Few-Shot Learners
venue: Advances in Neural Information Processing Systems
abstract: Recent work has demonstrated substantial gains on many NLP tasks and benchmarks by pre-training on a large corpus of text followed by fine-tuning on a specific task.

title: A Survey on Text Re-ranking in Information Retrieval
venue: Foundations and Trends in Information Retrieval
abstract: This survey reviews learning-to-rank, dense retrieval, cross-encoders, and hybrid ranking methods for modern text retrieval pipelines.

title: Cite from Description: Mapping Natural Language Paper Descriptions to Structured References
venue: Proceedings of the Joint Conference on Digital Libraries
abstract: We study the task of converting noisy natural-language descriptions of academic works into canonical metadata and BibTeX records through retrieval and reranking.

title: Crossref: The Sustainable Source of Community-Owned Scholarly Metadata
abstract: Crossref provides persistent identifiers and richly connected scholarly metadata that support discovery, citation linking, and research infrastructure.
publisher: Association of Learned and Professional Society Publishers
